summary: All 5 requirements from issue 546 are addressed. (1) Multi-agent wave execution wired into local pipeline runner via _run_multi_agent_phase() with spawn_fn callable pattern. (2) Plan-phase roles (ARCHITECT, TASK_PLANNER, RISK_ANALYST) defined with correct dependency graph (ARCHITECT → TASK_PLANNER + RISK_ANALYST parallel). (3) Reviewer roles (REVIEWER_UNIFIED, REVIEWER_CODE, REVIEWER_CONTRACT, REVIEWER_AGENT_DESIGN) unified into the orchestrator with read-only file access and INTEGRATOR dependency. (4) Multi-agent is configurable and opt-in via PipelineConfig.multi_agent, PhaseAgentConfig overrides, and --multi-agent/--max-parallel CLI flags; single-CODER fallback preserved. (5) Conflict resolution is scaffolded: detect_write_overlaps() detects overlapping file patterns and AgentExecutionModel.conflicts field tracks results, but the actual git merge-attempt after wave completion is not yet implemented. This is acceptable since the feature is opt-in and the scaffolding provides a solid foundation for a follow-up. Agent role enums are synchronized across all 4 locations (contracts, orchestrator models, gateway, dispatch). 14 new integration tests cover plan-phase roles, reviewer roles, write-overlap detection, and multi-agent config. All 3226 tests pass, lint clean.
